title: Builder BLD-104: Selection and parts overlay

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-104.

detail: B1 Shell, pass BLD-104 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-104). Selection and parts overlay. Scope: components/builder/canvas. Build: Hover outlines a data-part; click selects section or part. Inline text editing on text parts; image part opens the media picker with focal point. Section toolbar: move, duplicate, hide on this device, delete with undo toast. Done when: Canvas edit updates Tune rail and back; Every action is one undo step. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), a11y ratchet, pr-compare visual suite, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-101. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder spec. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-104.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
